resources.string: Off: other apps get Taildrive files as a stream — a copy goes at full speed, a player plays from the start and cannot seek. TailSocks\'s own browser still hands films and music to a player by the Taildrive proxy\'s link when the proxy is on, and that link seeks.
On: a player can jump about in a film another app opened from Taildrive. Every read then goes through TailSocks, so copying a file is slower — much slower while TailSocks is not on the screen.
Whether other apps can seek in Taildrive files, or copy them at full speed
